per_rule.rule: Every S_N in Acc_Info_dirty must exist as S_N in Cust_Bio_dirty (one-to-one relationship)
S_N must be unique across all records (no duplicates allowed)
Account_No must be exactly 4 digits (1000-9999)
Account_No must be unique across all records
Full_Name should be in Title Case (excluding lowercase particles: bin, binte, d/o, s/o)
Full_Name must not contain double spaces (consecutive whitespace characters)
ID must follow Singapore NRIC/FIN format: one prefix letter (S, T, F, G), followed by 7 digits, ending with one checksum letter
JoinDate must not be null
JoinDate must be a parseable datetime string
JoinDate must not be in the future
LastLogin must be a parseable datetime string
JoinDate must be on or before LastLogin (account creation precedes last activity)
Subscription_Type must be one of the valid subscription tiers
SubscriptionFee must not be null
SubscriptionFee must be numeric (parseable as float)
SubscriptionFee must not contain sentinel value '99999' indicating missing/unknown data
If Subscription_Type is 'Free', SubscriptionFee must be 0 or NULL
Status must use the dominant boolean representations True or False
AccountBalance must not contain sentinel value 99999.0 indicating missing/invalid data
AccountBalance must not be negative (unless overdrafts are explicitly permitted)
PreferredLanguage must be a valid language option
Device must be a valid device type
OS must be a canonical operating system name (Android, iOS, Linux, Windows, macOS)
FeedbackScore must be between 1.0 and 5.0 inclusive
FeedbackScore must not contain sentinel value 7.3 indicating missing/invalid data
FeedbackScore and FeedbackScore1 must be consistent (nearly duplicate columns should match)
Full_Name must be consistent with Cust_Bio_dirty.Name (accounting for case differences and name particles)
ID must exactly match Cust_Bio_dirty.ID_No for the same S_N
